description:

Conflicted files: unknown

Diff context:

handoff_summary.completed: 1. Added `.takt/beads/*.json` pattern to `.gitignore` to convert untracked bead files to ignored files — committed as "chore: ignore bead state JSON files to unblock main merge". 2. Merged main into feature/b-5c40fb01. 3. Resolved all 10 modify/delete conflicts (B-0ef0d5dd, B-1578cee1, B-37569c46, B-4e4ef869, B-4f956401, B-64e7c3af, B-7e5a7f1b, B-b224e1aa, B-d4849eef, B-eb8424da) by accepting the feature branch deletions via git rm. 4. Completed merge commit. Feature branch now includes all main changes including .apm/skills/skill-memory/ artifacts.
handoff_summary.remaining: None — the merge conflict is fully resolved and the feature branch is up to date with main.
handoff_summary.risks: Future merges from main will not re-introduce this issue since .takt/beads/*.json is now gitignored. The .gitkeep file in .takt/beads/ is no longer tracked (was lost in the merge); if the pipeline requires it, a follow-up may be needed to restore it.
handoff_summary.next_action: The feature branch is now current with main and ready for normal pipeline processing.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None remaining. The .gitignore rule prevents recurrence of the untracked-files merge blocker.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Resolved modify/delete conflicts in favor of deletion (feature branch intent) rather than keeping main's versions, consistent with the prior "untrack bead state" commit's intent.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests required — this is a git/configuration fix with no code logic changes.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The .takt/beads/.gitkeep file is no longer tracked after the merge. If the pipeline relies on .gitkeep to ensure the directory exists in fresh checkouts, a follow-up commit may be needed.

conflict_risks: None remaining. The .gitignore rule prevents recurrence of the untracked-files merge blocker.

execution_history.summary: Resolved the merge conflict blocking the feature/b-5c40fb01 branch from merging main. The root cause was that the prior "untrack bead state" commit removed .takt/beads/*.json files from git tracking but left them on disk as untracked files. When git tried to merge main (which has them tracked), it refused to overwrite untracked files. Fix: added .takt/beads/*.json to .gitignore so files became "ignored" instead of "untracked", committed that change, then completed the merge from main resolving 10 modify/delete conflicts by accepting the feature branch's deletions (keeping the intent to not track bead state on the feature branch).
